finding.title: sdd-workspace isolates linked git worktrees via per-worktree git rev-parse --show-toplevel hashing
finding.detail: Empirical check and tests/claude-code/test-sdd-workspace.sh:203-216 confirm each git worktree gets a distinct top-level path hash and isolated workspace directory.
